speaker: marty
flavor: Boss! My phone won't stop ringing. Don't panic. Okay, panic a little.
title: The first truck is stuck
text: The truck carrying the capsule frame is stuck two states away. Nothing can be built until it gets here.

choices.label: Pay $10M for a fast courier
choices.result: A courier races the frame over. It arrives the same night.

choices.label: Wait three days
choices.result: The truck rolls in three days late. The team gets to work.

choices.label: Reroute the truck
choices.result: One clever detour later, the frame arrives the next morning.

speaker: marty
flavor: I counted that pallet three times. Thrice! Now it's gone.
title: A shipment goes missing
text: A pallet of fuel valves has vanished from the loading dock. The capsule can't be finished without them.

choices.label: Pay to rush a new one
choices.result: One very expensive phone call later, new valves are on the way.

choices.label: Wait for the next truck
choices.result: A week of waiting. The valves finally arrive.

choices.label: Have an engineer make one
choices.result: The new valve is a little rough, but it fits.

speaker: rosa
flavor: It's like unplugging the TV in a storm. A little care now saves a lot later.
title: A storm rolls over the pad
text: A thunderstorm hits while the rocket is being put together. Lightning lands close to the pad.

choices.label: Install lightning protection
choices.result: Tall rods now guard the pad. A strike is far less likely to reach the rocket.

choices.label: Skip it
choices.result: The storm passes. The pad stays as it is.

speaker: hal
flavor: I've seen this movie before. Don't like how it ends.
title: A line in the weld
text: A scan shows a faint line in one of the capsule's welds. It may be a crack. It may be nothing.

choices.label: Ask the inspector to check it
choices.result: A careful check finds a small flaw. It gets fixed in a day.

choices.label: Take it apart and check by hand
choices.result: Four slow days. The weld is redone and it is solid.

choices.label: Ship it as it is
choices.result: The capsule moves on. Nobody knows what that line was.

speaker: dev
flavor: Cool cool cool. So the pretend rocket crashed. Only the pretend one!
title: The simulator finds a bug
text: A practice flight in the simulator crashed. There is a bug in the flight software.

choices.label: Fix it now
choices.result: Two days of careful work. The bug is gone and tested.

choices.label: Patch it later
choices.result: The bug goes on a to-do list. The list is getting long.
